findings.reported: UANI reported no tanker carrying Iranian crude successfully departing the Gulf of Oman and avoiding U.S. blockade enforcement since July 12, before July 14 reinstatement; approximately 12 small tankers carrying Iranian LPG passed the blockade line after reinstatement.
findings.interpretation_guardrail: This is UANI's tracked sample and commodity-specific finding. Do not infer an absolute impossibility of unobserved departures or conflate crude with LPG/jet fuel.

findings.reported: UANI identified at least 54 tankers laden with Iranian oil and other petroleum products along the Iranian coastline, and at least 58 oil/petrochemical loadings since July 14, of which eight were at Kharg Island.
findings.interpretation_guardrail: A loading or stationary laden tanker is neither an export nor a successful blockade transit. Snapshot populations must not be added across reporting days.

findings.reported: UANI reports tanker OLYM (IMO 9212759) transferred approximately 200,000 barrels of Iranian crude to HAO FAN (IMO 9258167) south of Kharg Island; HAO FAN's AIS location was reportedly spoofed near Shinas.
findings.interpretation_guardrail: UANI explicitly says the transfer may indicate an effort to export and breach the blockade but other explanations remain possible. No confirmed post-transfer export or blockade passage.

findings.reported: UANI reported satellite-confirmed ship-to-ship crude and fuel transfers in or near the Strait of Hormuz.
findings.interpretation_guardrail: Reconcile vessel IDs and dates to avoid duplicate counting with November 17 OLYM/HAO FAN and related reporting. Transfer is not proof of passage.

findings.reported: CENTCOM/NAVCENT advisory extends potential enforcement to recipients of Iranian-loaded ship-to-ship cargo, including vessels that never enter Iranian ports. Neutral passage to/from non-Iranian destinations is separately addressed.
findings.interpretation_guardrail: Advisory is an enforcement policy change, not evidence every involved vessel was seized or that neutral commercial Hormuz transits ceased.

findings.reported: UANI reported 106 U.S.-facilitated commercial Hormuz transits during November 15–18; 541 total month-to-date over 18 days and 3,630 across a 152-day observed campaign.
findings.interpretation_guardrail: Provider-labelled facilitated transits are not a complete independently verified census. Transits include non-Iranian traffic and must not be used to infer Iranian crude exports.

findings.reported: U.S. Treasury designated four Iranian individuals described as oil trustees. This establishes the U.S. administrative action and the government's allegations, not independent proof of every predicate alleged.
findings.interpretation_guardrail: Register as sanctions action, not as successful Iranian oil-export volume.

findings.reported: UANI assessed that container ship ZYRA (IMO 9237084) possibly breached the blockade while AIS-dark after anchoring near Jask.
findings.interpretation_guardrail: POSSIBLE rather than established, a container vessel rather than an Iranian-crude-laden tanker, and not evidence for crude-oil blockade breach.
